heading.title: Third Division · Part I · Applications in Specified Cases

article.title: Twelve years.
article.content:
Article136Twelve years.

The Schedule  ·  Third Division—Applications · Part I—Applications in Specified Cases
For the execution of any decree (other than a decree granting a mandatory injunction) or order of any civil court.
Period of limitationTwelve years.

Time from which period begins to run1[When] the decree or order becomes enforceable or where the decree or any subsequent order directs any payment of money or the delivery of any property to be made at a certain date or at recurring periods, when default in making the payment or delivery in respect of which execution is sought, takes place: Provided that an application for the enforcement or execution of a decree granting a perpetual injunction shall not be subject to any period of limitation.



1 Subs. by Act 53 of 1964, s. 3 and the Second Schedule, for “Where” (w.e.f. 12-12-1964.)
